title: Non-blocking follow-up from PR #151 review (frontend-channel-overlay)
description: Tracked non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #151 (frontend-channel-overlay), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's 'every non-blocking finding becomes a tracked task' rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges. Distinct from the PR's own blocking finding (the candlestick-occlusion bug), which stays on frontend-channel-overlay itself and must be fixed before that PR can be accepted.

checklist.step: Consider a lightweight visual-regression/screenshot check for the chart panes (PriceChart.tsx/OscillatorChart.tsx). No existing test -- neither the mocked vitest unit tests (which stub addSeries/setData and never render real pixels) nor the persisted Playwright e2e suite (which asserts on DOM/console state, not chart pixel content) -- would have caught the PR #151 review's candlestick-occlusion bug (an opaque AreaSeries painting over real candlestick data). That bug was only found via a manual, one-off browser walkthrough. Worth evaluating whether a cheap screenshot-diff check on a couple of representative fixture tickers/ranges is warranted for this chart-rendering-order class of bug, or whether the cost/flakiness of visual-regression tooling outweighs the benefit here -- a genuine judgment call, not a mandate to add one.
